name: EGWF Rocky Mountain Championship
epitaph: Senator Johnson pinned Ares for the title on EGWF Saturday Night, the fed's own build show for its first PPV, Armegedon -- despite Rainman's own interference against Johnson mid-match. A companion sighting on a rival fed's (EHWF's) own results show independently corroborates this title's existence.

name: EGWF Rocky Mountain Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Studly's won the tag title from the Irish Inmates in a No-DQ match on EGWF Saturday Night, a chaotic finish with an uncredited interferer taking out most of both teams before the fall.
